name: tinytex (legacy stub)
description: TinyTeX (lightweight TeX Live distribution) for LaTeX/PDF rendering used by Quarto and document tooling.

postInstallCheck.command: sh -c 'command -v pdflatex >/dev/null 2>&1 && pdflatex --version || command -v tlmgr >/dev/null 2>&1 && tlmgr --version || echo "TinyTeX not found"'
postInstallCheck.description: Verify pdflatex or tlmgr is available for TinyTeX/TeXLive
